Name: Traceability core
Notes: The spine join + validation + gate harness: trace.py (the SN->SR->LLR->TC join, orphans, id/structure integrity, off-spine tiers), check.py (the gate/tier harness that never a false-greens), and check_trajectory.py (the work-item registry + the status.md SSOT rules + the architecture-connectivity and How-SW top-view coverage).

Name: Generators
Notes: The generated views/indexes/bundles - every one --check-gated so it cannot silently rot: gen_arch_map (the module map), gen_trajectory (this PROJECT_STATE dashboard), gen_okf (the OKF knowledge bundle), gen_release_checklist, gen_skills_index, and gen_cases (dimensional test-case expansion).

Name: Quality checkers
Notes: The doc/code quality lints run at their declared gate: check_docs (navigability + vision), check_doc_refs (dead path/symbol refs), check_dupes (copy-paste blocks), check_flows (runtime-flow conformance), check_perf (budgets/regressions), check_stubs (the substance tripwire), and check_vendored (vendored-doc drift).

Name: Unattended loop & floor
Notes: The headless coordinator and the always-on safety floor: agent_loop (resume + typed outcomes + review/critique dispatch), agent_route (model routing + escalation), score_reviews (the substance scorer), subagent_gate (spawn control), and check_privacy (the secrets/privacy floor the pre-commit/pre-push hooks run).

Name: Scaffold & onboarding
Notes: The zero-to-running surface: bootstrap (the scaffolder + diffable re-sync), run_menu (the run capability menu behind the delegate run.* launchers), and the onboard/dev-setup templates that wire the process floor from the rung a contributor actually runs.
